profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a team oriented Full Stack Engineer who enjoys working with others to develop creative solutions to difficult problems.  I aim to leverage my skills to provide clients or companies with complete solutions that offer both satisfaction and simplicity.

My ability to pickup new languages on the fly and to problem solve issues is a perk as my experience allows me to move quickly and adapt to a dynamic environment.

Languages/Frameworks: React, Vue, Angular JS, HTML, CSS, Python, Express, NodeJS, MongoDB, C#, C++, Java, .Net Core

Utilities: VS Code, Microsoft Visual Studio, Git, Github, Heroku, Netlify, Postman, SQL Server

Work Patterns: Waterfall, Agile

Github: https://github.com/leepdev

positions.title: Software Engineer Immersive Fellow
positions.description:
Full-stack software engineering immersive student in an intensive, 24-week, 450+ hour program focused on product development fundamentals, object-oriented programming, MVC frameworks, data modeling, and team collaboration strategies. Developed a portfolio of individual and group projects.

Projects:
Build your own Browser Game - Utilizing HTML, JS/Jquery, CSS (bootstrap) - Role based baseball game related to the cheating scandal of the Houston Astros.

Currently working on the MERN Stack.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · REST APIs · HTML · Git · SQL · Node.js · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
I decided to pursue a role as a golf instructor and thus I attended classes online to obtain the right certifications.  

I went to students' home courses to teach them on the range.  The skills that I translated over were for beginner to intermediate level students (new beginners to mid-handicap players).  

I broke down my lessons into packages: Full Swing, Short game, putting.  I like to teach in layman's terms to simplify the learning process.  

Golf is complex and it does not come to people naturally unless they have a mind for body physics and how to pair that to the mechanics of the swing. 

Although I enjoyed this moment of my career, I decided that at this moment, I will pause and pursue full stack development.
